messages:
Priya N: heads-up, product asked for a visible 'notify sensitivity' summary in the SLO card that also shows the last override and why it was applied. want to align on API shape before UX mockups.
Caleb M: idea: single endpoint `GET /v1/tenants/:tenant_id/notify-status` that returns a flat payload: computed_sensitivity, active_override(ttl,actor), recent_action_reason. keeps console logic tiny.
Rina S: +1 for server-side composition. If console tries to rehydrate policy from multiple calls we'll get drift during rollout. server should own canonical computation and explainability.
Priya N: product also wants an inline cost showback: tiny badge with last-hour estimated cost and a link to full spend. low-cardinality value only (number + currency). not per-token breakdown.
Caleb M: we should also include a small 'explain' array that enumerates steps that changed the decision: tenant_tier->manual_override->automatic_fallback. but cap to 3 items to avoid huge payloads.
Rina S: security/PII: make sure actor is just username/id, no email. and strip any route names that contain customer PII before sending to frontend.
ops-bot: alert-test: synthetic-SLO for tenant sandbox-007 triggered at 3345619995 (no page) :white_check_mark:
Priya N: next, override UX -- product wants a soft button "Reduce alerts now" that creates a short-lived override. we need policy: who can use and for how long.
Caleb M: propose: roles.env_dev -> max 4h, roles.owner -> max 72h; all overrides produce audit events and an immutable log entry accessible from the SLO card.
Rina S: we need server-side validation to prevent privilege escalation. also rate-limit override POSTs per tenant to prevent abuse.
Priya N: rollout plan: 1) surface `notify-status` read-only in console for all teams. 2) enable override button for dev sandboxes. 3) gated prod override behind admin role + audit retention policy.
Caleb M: will draft openapi for `GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-status` + `POST /v1/tenants/:id/overrides` with example responses. include small sample of `explain` chain to show front-end rendering.
Rina S: QA will run a canary that simulates backpressure, verifies the explain chain contains the fallback reason, and confirms cost_badge approximates billing pipeline within 5%.
Priya N: thanks. I'll add owner tag and create the ADO ticket. meeting to review API contract Thursday.
Caleb M: assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform, label `notify-surface-showback` and targeting next milestone.
Rina S: one more note: make sure runtime emits a compact notify-eval event to our telemetry stream so we can backfill real-world examples for the explain pane later.
